So, that's something that interests you, consider subscribing and turn the bell notification on as well. And these 3X categories are pretty good. It encompasses a lot of travel purchases. And even covers gas and dining. It just has a lot of broad categories to people. And then you earn a point per dollar everywhere else, this card comes with no foreign transaction fees but it is an American Express card so worldwide acceptance might be an issue here. And most people might not give this card the light of day because it doesnt look that impressive. After doing the best you do and you continue to earn $12,500 you earn just one point per dollar. But this bonus takes commitment time and quite a bit of spending to hit that $12,500 limit. But it's the redemption opportunity on this card that makes this card a key piece in a Wells Fargo trifecta because what makes this card so great for the redemption side is the fact that you will receive a 50% more value for airline tickets when you book your airline tickets through the Wells Fargo Travel Portal. And if you happen to be a big spender after spending $50,000 in a calendar year, that redemption value goes from 1.5 cents per point up to 1.75 cents per point for airfare booked to the Wells Fargo Travel Portal. But I don't think many of you are going to spend that much on this card, nor is it really worth it if you have the CashWise card. But let's say instead you were to put $50,000 on your Cash Wise card and redeem it just $0.05 cents per point. You would have yourself $1,125 in rewards you an extra $250 in rewards. Now lets talk about combining your points because what�s great about Wells Fargo credit cards is that they're pretty lax on who you can move your points to because you can move your points from your own Wells Fargo Cards, or you can move them from other people as well. Which makes this a great benefit It makes it extremely easy to pool your points with yourself. Or with other people and it makes it great for this rotation Because you take into account that one point five cent per point redemption value with that Visa Signature Card that means those three X categories on the Propel card turned into four and a half percent. And the cash wise, one point five percent becomes two point two five percent and if you were to make mobile wallet payments in that first year it becomes two point seven percent. So let's take a look at how this rotation would look because you would be earning triple points on gas, dining, rideshares, flights, hotels, homestays, car rentals, and streaming services and the 1.5X everywhere else. and then you'd have your visa signature card to give you that 1.5 cent per point uplift. What's interesting about these earning rates is that it matches what you would get from a chase sapphire reserve, and chase freedom unlimited combination for non-bonus spend. And the wells fargo propell card has better 3x categories than the chase sapphire reserve. Now I realize chase offers you transfer partners, but if you are someone who uses the chase travel portal with your chasing sapphire reserve. You have the option to have essentially the same earning rates with the Wells Fargo trifecta but even better it has no annual fee, but the downside is that 1.5 cent per point redemption value for the Wells Fargo trifecta is only good for airfare while Chase is good for all travels through their portal but if you use your points for airfare this is actually a pretty solid return for an easy three card rotation. And Wells Fargo has their in-store offers. Which are similar to American Express offers. And these earn GoFar rewards. And GoFar rewards have some pretty good offers. So you can earn yourself a lot of extra points here. And they even have their own shopping portal as well. But Wells Fargo does have some bonus restrictions for their cards. As you can earn one bonus every 15 months with Wells Fargo cards. So it would take quite a bit of time to get the bonus for all 3 cards if you were a solo player in this game. And that's definitely a negative, but if you happen to have a player 2, then you can reduce the timeframe here. Although it would still take some time to get a third card in this trifecta with a bonus unless you wanted to forgo a bonus and just get the card anyways now let's take a look at some other benefits of this trifecta and you would think for a trifecta with no annual fee it would be pretty limited on the benefits side but there are actually quite a few good benefits to this rotation first you're gonna receive up to $600 in cell phone protection and it only comes with a $25 deductible. You'll also get extended warranty coverage, retail protection for items that are lost or stolen in the first 90 days of purchase, up to $3000 in lost luggage coverage and price protection. So while Wells Fargo credit cards might not be the cards you look at first, when you look at the earning rates on these cards, you realize Wells Fargo has put together a decent 3 card setup that comes with no annual fee that could work well for people who like to book airline tickets in economy class. And, sure, Wells Fargo lacks transfer partners but if you are someone utilizing Ultimate Reward Points as cash to book flights to the Chase travel portal basically you are using ultimate reward points the same way you would use the Wells Fargo points. I think it is really hard to argue against that this trifecta can offer some pretty solid value for someone who flies coach and offer no annual fees.
